sources.title: Breaking: New wildfire reported in Los Angeles County on Nov. 15
Two weeks left of hurricane season

en.title: Wildfire Reported in Los Angeles County on November 15
facts: The Sacramento Bee reported a new wildfire in Los Angeles County on November 15.
FOX 13 Tampa Bay reported that two weeks remained in hurricane season on November 15.
body: The Sacramento Bee reported a new wildfire in Los Angeles County on November 15.
On that date, FOX 13 Tampa Bay stated that two weeks remained in hurricane season.

it.title: Incendio boschivo segnalato nella contea di Los Angeles il 15 novembre
facts: Il Sacramento Bee ha riferito di un nuovo incendio boschivo nella contea di Los Angeles il 15 novembre.
FOX 13 Tampa Bay ha riferito che il 15 novembre mancavano due settimane alla fine della stagione degli uragani.
body: Il Sacramento Bee ha riferito di un nuovo incendio boschivo nella contea di Los Angeles il 15 novembre.
In quella data, FOX 13 Tampa Bay ha dichiarato che mancavano due settimane alla fine della stagione degli uragani.

pt.title: Incêndio florestal comunicado no condado de Los Angeles a 15 de novembro
facts: O The Sacramento Bee noticiou um novo incêndio florestal no condado de Los Angeles a 15 de novembro.
A FOX 13 Tampa Bay noticiou que faltavam duas semanas para o fim da época de furacões a 15 de novembro.
body: O Sacramento Beenoticiou um novo incêndio florestal no condado de Los Angeles a 15 de novembro.
Na mesma data, a FOX 13 Tampa Bay afirmou que faltavam duas semanas para o fim da época de furacões.

problemsFixed: The draft includes a 'dek' which is not required by the style guide and is not a single-sentence summary under 30 words; the style guide requires a factual headline only.
The body paragraphs are repetitive and do not adhere to the rhythm requirement (varying sentence length and avoiding four short declarative sentences in a row).
The context section attempts to explain *why* events are happening, which requires speculation or external knowledge not present in the sources; the style guide demands facts only.
The structure is too fragmented; the body must read as prose, not a list of attributed statements.
The draft does not adhere to the rule of opening paragraphs with the actor, number, or date, as the body starts with the actor (Sacramento Bee).
